React Router v8 SPA + SSR · TypeScript + Tailwind
3 · Application tier — Google Cloud Run (container, scale 0→N)
routes each turn to one specialist agent, persists state transition
6 · Google Cloud platform services (consumed by tiers 3–5, no direct client access)

Single deployable container: the React Router server hosts both SSR and the /api surface. Orchestrator and agents are server-side modules, extractable to a dedicated Cloud Run service without any client change.
